name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.
texts: Grab the key at least once
The goal is not reached before the key is held
Reach the goal square if possible
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 12
